description: What exactly did that backtest do? Returns the full record of ONE backtest run by id: strategy, pair, interval, date range, parameters, filters and the aggregate metrics (CAGR, total return, win-rate, max drawdown, trade count, Buy & Hold comparison, net-of-fees figures). Only your own runs (admins may read others). Get ids from arena_list_backtests; for the individual trades add arena_get_backtest_trades; to create a new run use arena_run_backtest. [API Pro tier]
name: arena_get_backtest
title: Get Backtest Detail
